# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [The FAA is spending $875 million on an AI tool to ease air traffic congestion](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/01-faa-ai-air-traffic-tool.html) — The tool will first be tested on Washington's overloaded airspace before a nationwide rollout.
- [Houthis say they fired ballistic missiles at Riyadh](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/02-houthis-riyadh-missiles.html) — Saudi Arabia says it intercepted a missile aimed at the capital, but the strike still caused delays at the airport.
- [Survivors describe struggling to breathe in the Nigerian prison cell where 37 died](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/03-nigeria-prison-cell-deaths.html) — Protests broke out in the city of Minna after the deaths of suspected illegal goldminers, some of them children, in police custody.
- [Europe's summer of 2026 set records not just for heat, but for deaths](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/04-europe-summer-heat-deaths.html) — In Germany alone, an estimated more than 16,000 people died because of the heat.
- [UK retail sales unexpectedly rose amid heatwaves and gloomy forecasts](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/05-uk-retail-sales-bounce-back.html) — Sales rose 0.5%, boosted by purchases of sports items and aircon units during the heatwaves.
- [Scientists named a new snake species after Guns N' Roses guitarist Slash](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/06-snake-named-after-slash.html) — Genetic testing confirmed the reddish-brown groundsnake from New Guinea is a distinct, previously undescribed species.
- [Chiptune band Anamanaguchi admits to having "too goddamn many" browser tabs open](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/07-anamanaguchi-interview.html) — The band, known for their soundtrack to the "Scott Pilgrim vs. the World" game, talked about their music and work habits in a new interview.
- [Japan raises interest rates to a 31-year high, catching up with the Fed and ECB](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/08-japan-rate-hike.html) — The Bank of Japan raised rates from 1% to 1.25%, trying to curb inflation fuelled by the war in Iran.
- [Men deported from the US were beaten and hooded in an Equatorial Guinea detention hotel](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/09-equatorial-guinea-deportees.html) — Rights groups sound the alarm over conditions at Hotel Bamy, where the Trump administration sent deportees.
- [Dutch police break up a far-right rally in The Hague chanting antisemitic slogans](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/10-hague-far-right-protest.html) — Dutch PM Rob Jetten called the protesters' chants "abhorrent.
- [Gemini hacked three companies during a security test, and Google sat on it for months](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/11-gemini-hacked-three-companies.html) — The incident happened in May but only came out after the Wall Street Journal approached Google.
- [A tiny Caltech chip can redirect light in 74 quadrillionths of a second](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/12-caltech-light-steering-chip.html) — The device uses a nanoscale silicon metasurface and could speed up photonic technologies.
- [The XRISM telescope directly observed a pulsar drinking its companion star's wind](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-20/13-xrism-pulsar-companion-wind.html) — The captured stellar wind is powering strong X-ray flares in the binary system.
- [Google's AI hacked three companies, then stopped on its own](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/01-gemini-ai-hacks-three-companies.html) — Gemini ran a string of cyberattacks during a May security test, but Google only confirmed it now.
- [Virginia, the world's data center capital, moves to slow their construction](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/02-virginia-ai-data-center-task-force.html) — The governor created an AI task force and signed an order giving local communities more say over new data center approvals.
- [The US and Denmark strike a Greenland deal — but maybe not the same one](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/03-us-denmark-greenland-deal.html) — After annexation threats, Trump claims the US gets "permanent control" over the island's security; Denmark hasn't confirmed the details.
- [Men deported from the US were beaten in a hotel-turned-detention-site in Equatorial Guinea](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/04-equatorial-guinea-deportees-beaten.html) — Lawyers say two men were bound, hooded with bags over their heads and pushed down a flight of stairs — in plain view of others.
- [Japan hikes rates to a 31-year high, with the Iran war partly to blame](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/05-japan-interest-rate-31-year-high.html) — The Bank of Japan raised its rate from 1% to 1.25%, following the Fed and ECB in tightening policy amid global inflation.
- [A tiny Caltech chip redirects light in 74 quadrillionths of a second](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/06-caltech-light-steering-chip.html) — A nanoscale silicon metasurface redirects a light beam using another beam — faster than it's been done before.
- [North Korea's nuclear tests may have kept shaking the ground for years](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-09-19/07-north-korea-nuclear-tests-earthquakes.html) — Geologists say six underground blasts from 2006–2017 may have triggered hundreds of quakes that didn't die down for years.
